_provenance.notes: The CDQ Program was established in 1992 under the Magnuson-Stevens Act to provide 65 western Alaska communities a guaranteed share of Bering Sea groundfish, crab, and halibut TACs. Six nonprofit CDQ groups manage allocations for their member communities. Total CDQ allocations include 10.7% of all Bering Sea/Aleutian Islands (BSAI) groundfish, 10% of halibut (Area 4A-4E), and 7.5% of crab species. CDQ groups generated over $200M in revenue in 2023.
